comments.text:
Don’t even say that 😭 Sir, Class 10 Maths is much harder than Class 9.

In Class 9, questions come only from NCERT. But in Class 10, you never know where the questions come from. In the exam, there was only one question from NCERT (I’m in Standard Maths). I know that in Standard Maths the paper isn’t usually set directly from NCERT, but it’s not supposed to be this difficult either. I solved around 100 questions from every chapter, and even after that, the paper went so badly.

Some questions were from easy chapters but were made very difficult — especially that 5-mark question from Triangles. And don’t even get me started on the case study!

The paper was so lengthy that even the questions I knew, I couldn’t finish properly. It honestly felt like we were giving a JEE-level exam.
